settings.variant_description: Production with RERANK_ENABLED=false: vector top 5, top 4, _select_evidence. Computed from the baseline's cache.
settings.rerank_stage_note: With reranking off the rerank stage is the vector top 5 unchanged, so its recall@8 is n/a.
settings.vector_store: qdrant embedded local mode (exact search), eval/cache/qdrant
settings.keep_live_hits: not called (needs Postgres); all eval papers are indexed, so it keeps every hit
summary: Pages: PyMuPDF physical pages from 1, clean_text per page, pages under 100 chars skipped; RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter 1500 chars, 300 overlap; payload paper = file name.
Embeddings: Voyage voyage-4, input_type document for chunks and query for the question; Qdrant 1024-d cosine.
Search: query_points limit 8, owner_id filter; keep_live_hits skipped (would keep every hit here).
Rerank off (RERANK_ENABLED=false): rerank_results keeps the vector top 5 unchanged; no rerank call.
Vector search: Qdrant embedded local mode (exact search). At this collection size Qdrant Cloud generally searches exactly too, so rankings should match; not verified against Cloud.
Context: top 4 after rerank, _select_evidence within 4000 chars.
